> "In the demo I set contamination to 0.05, so the model flags the top five percent of points as anomalies. Set it too high and you start flagging normal data."

So contamination controls what fraction of data the model considers anomalies — if it's set too high, the model will incorrectly flag normal (non-anomalous) data points.
